chunks: It is narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
Shaving the head outside of hajj or 'umrah is disfigurement for your enemies and beauty for you.

key_terms.حَلْقُ: shaving; the act of removing hair

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about shaving the head outside hajj and 'umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام addresses the ruling and meaning of shaving the head outside the rituals of hajj and 'umrah. It presents head-shaving in this context as a mark of humiliation for enemies, while for the believers it is described as a form of beauty.
